findings.text: the equality gate builds its jets by stacking the analytic certificate field's value, gradient and Hessian at the sample nodes, not by lean_map.jets.build_jets on the carrier as done_when clause (2) specifies; the 282-cell carrier, its geometry and its 1164 sample nodes are real, so a genuine 0.0 comparison is made, but the production jet-assembly path the done-when names is never exercised and a divergence entering through it would not be seen. The worker reports this under follow_ons as a time-budget fallback (the read/booking/jet stage timed out at 540 s), so it is a disclosed deviation rather than a silent one.

max_transforms_vs_production compares fixed_points.build_mesh against bell.build_mesh, but bell.build_mesh IS the imported fixed_points.build_mesh, so the two sides are one function applied to identical arguments and the reported 0.0 is identically zero for any implementation; the manifest quotes it at manifest.md:15 as corroboration, where it carries no information.

the re-export is guarded by no committed test: grep over tests/ for read_route finds only tests/test_fused_same_state_read.py, which uses 'read route' as a concept and imports nothing from this module, so a regression that reinstates the deleted copies or drops a re-exported name is caught by nothing in the suite — only by the run-directory script importer_imports.py, which is not committed.
